A '''bloodstone crystal''' was a rare kind of [[tasar crystal]] that had the ability to turn an individual [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and to imbue them with a specific [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] after several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of attunement. The bloodstone crystal was a deep purple in color, and had the ability to grant an individual the power of [[Reduce Injury|wound reduction]], allowing an individual to decrease the severity of any wound. The [[Tasari]] cult leader [[Garuk]] wore a golden amulet inset with three tasar crystals, including a bloodstone crystal. [[Valjak]], a Tasari member of the [[Kiana]], wielded a [[Sword/Legends|sword]] with a bloodstone crystal on the pommel.<ref name="J15" />
